title: Phantom of the Paradise — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about Phantom of the Paradise. Phantom of the Paradise is a 1974 American rock musical comedy horror film written and directed by Brian De Palma, and scored by and starring Paul Williams. The film follows a naïve young singer-songwriter, Winslow Leach (William Finley), who is tricked by legendary but unscrupulous music producer Swan (Williams) into sacrificing his life's work.

Meaning is not found in Phantom of the Paradise — it is manufactured for it. In the recording studio segment of the video, Sinclar even says "Filter!" in reference to the film when Swan filters the damaged singing voice of Phantom. A successful concert production of the show, adapted by Weasel War Dance Productions, premiered March 12, 2018, at The Secret Loft in New York City.
